description: Codex lifecycle hooks — the host-portable subset of claude-hooks.json. Excluded on purpose: statusline-install (writes ~/.claude/settings.json), subagent-stop (Codex has no SubagentStop delivery for plugin hooks), and auto-capture (its captured-signal check scans the turn's raw transcript JSONL, which last_assistant_message does not carry). stop-guard IS portable — it reads last_assistant_message first and only falls back to a transcript — so it runs here too. Everything else runs on both hosts. SessionEnd is declared at 3s because Codex clamps that event's timeout to 3s regardless of what is written here. PreToolUse carries no matcher on purpose: Claude can filter to Bash by name, but Codex's shell tool is exec_command, so the guard decides from the payload shape and a name-based matcher would silently disarm it. Requires bun, like every studio hook.
